text:
arjun: Heads-up — I'm going to pin provider versions across several tf modules in staging to keep the lockfile consistent. It's a refactor: hoisting the aws provider to the root, setting explicit versions (aws, azurerm, google). I'll regenerate .terraform.lock.hcl. Quick sanity check requested before I merge. /cc @mira @sasha

mira: which modules are affected? any risk of resource replacement?

arjun: infra/network, infra/eks, infra/rds, infra/iam, infra/monitoring. I ran terraform init -upgrade && terraform plan in infra/eks and infra/rds locally — plan shows no resource diffs, only provider constraint changes. snippet from the root provider block:
```
provider "aws" {
  region  = var.region
  version = "~> 4.42"
  assume_role {
    role_arn = var.cross_account_role_arn
  }
}
```
Also added an aliased provider for iam cross-account calls.

dev-bot: CI: PR #4821 — plan check passed, no changes detected. :white_check_mark:

sasha: quick q — any secret name/path changes? apps team needs to know if helm values need updates (cluster-autoscaler, rds creds).

arjun: No secret names changed. I did rename a TF variable: db_credentials_path -> rds_credentials_path inside the rds module. To avoid breaking callers I added a compatibility mapping in the root module: 
```
rds_credentials_path = var.db_credentials_path != "" ? var.db_credentials_path : var.rds_credentials_path
```
However I found one mismatch in staging helm values: the autoscaler chart expects the secret key "pass" while our generated secret uses "password".

ops-oncall: FYI I saw a failed rollout this morning where autoscaler errored reading secret "cluster-autoscaler-creds" key "pass". We should standardize to "password". I'll open a tiny PR to change the helm template and also patch staging now to avoid breaks.

jen: Small ops ask: when you regen the lockfile, can you commit the lockfile to the repo and add a git tag so our canary job pulls an exact revision? ops wants predictable checkout for the deployer image.

arjun: Yep — plan is to commit the regenerated .terraform.lock.hcl in the root and submodule roots where applicable, and add tag staging/pin-2026-03-01 after merge. Will also add a short note in the PR that explains the hoist and the var compatibility mapping. I'm aiming to merge after 12:00 UTC unless objections.

mira: lgtm from infra side. :thumbsup:

sasha: apps side good as long as ops patches the helm key. :thumbsup:

arjun: merging now. I'll watch the canary rollout and post updates here if anything regresses. Thanks all.
